turns.sentence: Great job on the report this week.
Thank you, I worked hard on it.
It really showed. Keep it up.
Your presentation was solid, but I think it could use clearer transitions between sections.
That's helpful — do you have an example of where it felt disjointed?
Right around slide six, it jumped from the budget to the timeline pretty abruptly.
Got it, I'll add a short summary sentence to bridge those two sections.
That should do it — otherwise it was a strong presentation overall.
I want to be direct with you — some stakeholders felt your last update lacked the detail they needed to make a decision.
I appreciate you telling me directly — could you help me understand which specific details were missing?
Mainly the risk assessment — they wanted to see potential downsides, not just the upside projections.
That's fair, and honestly a gap I hadn't considered. I'll build that into the next version.
I appreciate you taking it this well — it wasn't easy feedback to deliver, but I think it'll strengthen your work.
